description: Main source file for the Host Orchestrator server in the Android Cuttlefish project. It sets up HTTP server, proxy routes, and orchestrator configurations, serving as the entry point of the application.

methods.name: defaultCVDArtifactsDir
methods.description: Returns the default directory path for CVD artifacts based on current user.

methods.name: startHttpServer
methods.description: Starts an HTTP server listening at the specified address and port.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Runs multiple starter functions concurrently, waiting for all to complete.

methods.name: newOperatorProxy
methods.description: Creates a reverse proxy to forward requests to the operator service running on specified port.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point of the application, parsing flags, initializing components, and starting the server.
